body:
## Purpose

Current vLLM v1 CPU KV-offload eviction policies (LRU, ARC) treat blocks as independent items. But a conversation's KV blocks are only useful as a whole chain — evicting one block in the middle forces recomputation of everything after it. SAE (Session-Aware Eviction) groups blocks stored by the same request into a *session* and evicts session-worst-first, tail-first, so shared prefixes outlive their suffixes. title: [Kernel] Fix cross-iteration shared-memory WAR races in Blackwell GDN prefill
body:
## Motivation

Two GDN CuTe DSL kernels overwrite shared-memory buffers at the start of
chunk iteration i+1 without ensuring all warps finished reading iteration i:

- `kernel_kkt_inv_uw.py`: `s_beta` and gating cumulative-sum buffers.
- `kernel_o.py`: `s_g_cu`, used to construct the exponential gating mask.

A lagging warp can therefore read values from two iterations. The
`kernel_o.py` path can amplify corrupted input through `exp()`.

## Modifications

Add a 128-thread named barrier at the end of each affected loop:

```python
cute.arch.barrier(barrier_id=1, number_of_threads=128)
```

The barriers execute every iteration and order the final shared-memory reads
before the next iteration's stores.

## Accuracy Tests

The patched GDN prefill pipeline passes `test_gdn_prefill_cutedsl.py` on
B300 with output-error tolerance `2e-3`. Tested with SGLang's pinned

body:
Adds a Tensor-Descriptor (TD) operand-load path to `_w8a8_block_int8_matmul` (compressed-tensors / SGLang-style W8A8 block-wise INT8 GEMM).

On XPU, masked `tl.load` feeding `tl.dot` bypasses the Xe XMX 2D-block-read path, and the per-element address arithmetic dominates the int8 operand loads. title: [Fix] Forward scheduler SIGQUIT through the DP controller
body:
## Motivation

Fixes #40364 

When `DataParallelController` is used, DP schedulers are children of the controller rather than direct children of the Engine.

If a scheduler raises an exception, `run_scheduler_process()` sends `SIGQUIT` to its direct parent. In this process topology, that parent is the DP controller. Because the controller has no SIGQUIT handler, the default action terminates it instead of notifying the Engine.

## Motivation

On the FA3 extend path we copy `q` once per layer, per forward, and nothing needs the copy.

`q` arrives as a column slice of the fused QKV projection output — `qkv[:, :q_size]` — so its last dim is contiguous but its rows are strided over the K/V columns. The call site materialized that slice:

```python
